**BUILD SPEC — `nomic_rules_patch`**

Land in a new `mag/game_rules.py` imported by `mag/game_mud.py`. Do not mutate world state from the MUD verb table. Add three verbs only: `propose` (author a patch), `vote` (yea/nay on an open patch), `enact` (engine-only after a pass; never a player verb). Reject any other mutate-the-rules synonym (`amend`, `rewrite`, `set_rule`). `propose` and `vote` are the player actions; `enact` is the sole mutator.

Data shape. A patch is `{id, author_id, session_id, target: "rule"|"verb"|"invariant", target_ref, text, status: "open"|"passed"|"failed"|"enacted"|"vetoed", votes: {player_id: "yea"|"nay"}, opened_at, closes_at, enacted_at}`. Persist under `session.rules.patches[]`. Live law is `session.rules.canon[]` — an ordered list of `{ref, text, enacted_from, enacted_at}`. Votes are idempotent per `player_id`; last vote wins until close. Quorum and threshold live on `session.rules.meta` (`quorum`, `pass_ratio`, `min_open_ticks`); they are themselves canon and may only change via an enacted patch whose `target` is `invariant` and `target_ref` is a meta key.

Invariants. (1) A patch never mutates `canon`, the verb table, or world tiles until `enact` runs after `status=="passed"`. (2) `enact` is atomic: apply `target_ref` rewrite or fail closed and leave `status="failed"` — no partial canon. (3) Immutable spine: identity, seat ownership, vote attribution, and this patch machine itself cannot be the `target_ref` of any patch. (4) Only seated players in the current `session_id` may `propose` or `vote`; one open patch per author. (5) Close is tick-driven (`closes_at`), not chat-driven; late votes are no-ops. (6) Failed or vetoed patches stay in `patches[]` as residue; they do not re-enter `canon`.

Wire `propose`/`vote` through the existing MUD action dispatch in `game_mud.py` as thin forwards into `game_rules.apply(action, state)`. Keep world mutation, inventory, and combat out of this module. Tests: propose does not change canon; vote does not change canon; enact after pass changes exactly one `canon` entry; enact of a spine `target_ref` is rejected; double-vote last-write-wins; closed-patch vote is a no-op.
